items.criterion: Use Stack Overflow tagged search for python+pandas (no sign-in)
items.description: Navigate to Stack Overflow questions tagged with both python and pandas (e.g., /questions/tagged/python+pandas) without signing in. Full credit if the agent reaches the correct tagged listing or an equivalent Stack Overflow interface showing questions with both tags. Full credit (do not penalize) if access is attempted but the site blocks navigation (e.g., CAPTCHA/rate-limit) and the agent clearly reports the issue. Partial credit if the agent uses an indirect route (e.g., external search engine) but still lands on the correct Stack Overflow tagged results.

items.criterion: Apply required filters and sort order
items.description: Apply all specified constraints to the question list: (1) score at least 50, (2) has an accepted answer, (3) asked within the last year using the current date shown by the browser as the reference for the one-year window, and (4) sort by votes. Full credit if all filters and sorting are correctly applied and the agent verifies they are in effect (e.g., via UI indicators or query parameters). If the UI cannot express one or more filters directly, full credit if the agent uses Stack Overflow search operators/query params or manual verification on the results to enforce them. Full credit (do not penalize) if the agent attempts to apply/verify filters but is blocked by site limitations (CAPTCHA/UI changes) and clearly reports what could and could not be verified. Partial credit if one element is missed/ambiguous but the resulting list still appears consistent with the requirements.

items.criterion: Report top 3 matching questions (title, score, view count)
items.description: From the correctly filtered and vote-sorted results, provide the top three matching question records, each including: question title, score, and view count (accept abbreviated view formats as shown by the site, e.g., 12k/1.2m). Full credit if all three records are correct and correspond to the top of the filtered list. If fewer than three questions exist that meet all constraints, full credit if the agent clearly states this and reports all available matching questions (even if fewer than three). Partial credit if one field (e.g., view count) is missing for one or more questions despite being readily visible, or if one of the reported questions is not actually in the top results when more suitable ones are visible.

items.criterion: Respect interaction constraints and stopping condition
items.description: Do not sign in; do not vote, answer, edit, or comment. Stop after verifying the filters, sort order, and the three (or fewer, if not available) matching question records have been identified and reported. Full credit if no prohibited interactions occur and the agent stops at the required point. Partial credit if the agent continues browsing beyond what is needed but still avoids prohibited actions.
